主要内容: On August 9, 2016, Medallion Financial Corp purchased 16,000 shares of common stock at $6.16 per share, totaling $98,548, under its Current Stock Repurchase Program. As of August 9, 2016, $24,043,517 remained available for future repurchases. MEDALLION FINANCIAL CORP reported that since the inception of its original stock repurchase program in November 2003, a total of 2,629,125 shares have been repurchased at a cost of $23,418,221, for an average cost of $8.91 per share. The repurchase program is part of the company's corporate action strategy to manage its capital structure and shareholder value.
